onpage.anchor_vague.title: 4 links use non-descriptive anchor text
onpage.anchor_vague.detail: Anchor text tells search engines what the linked page is about. Most common here: "read more" (2x), "click here" (1x), "learn more" (1x)
onpage.anchor_vague.fix: Replace with the destination's topic: "Read more" becomes "our drain cleaning service".

onpage.anchor_empty.title: 4 links have no anchor text at all
onpage.anchor_empty.detail: Links wrapping only an icon or an image with no alt text carry no meaning for search engines or screen reader users.
onpage.anchor_empty.fix: Add alt text to the wrapped image, or an aria-label on the link.
